statements:
CREATE TABLE auth_attempts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ip_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	accepted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_auth_attempts_identity_created ON auth_attempts (identity_hash, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_auth_attempts_ip_created ON auth_attempts (ip_hash, created_at)

CREATE TABLE device_groups (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE hardware_profiles (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	profile_key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	vendor VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	board_names JSONB NOT NULL, 
	compatibles JSONB NOT NULL, 
	target VARCHAR(120), 
	soc_vendor VARCHAR(120), 
	soc_model VARCHAR(120), 
	cpu_vendor VARCHAR(120), 
	cpu_model VARCHAR(160), 
	cpu_architecture VARCHAR(80), 
	cpu_cores INTEGER, 
	cpu_max_mhz INTEGER, 
	sensor_roles JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	origin VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	observation_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	first_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	catalog_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (profile_key)
)

CREATE TABLE mobile_pairing_attempts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	accepted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_mobile_pairing_attempts_created ON mobile_pairing_attempts (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_mobile_pairing_attempts_identity_created ON mobile_pairing_attempts (identity_hash, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_mobile_pairing_attempts_token_created ON mobile_pairing_attempts (token_hash, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE settings (
	key VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	disabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

CREATE TABLE audit_log (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID, 
	action VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	object_type VARCHAR(80), 
	object_id VARCHAR(120), 
	details JSONB, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_log_created ON audit_log (created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE devices (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	group_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR(120), 
	hostname VARCHAR(120), 
	model VARCHAR(160), 
	firmware VARCHAR(160), 
	token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	previous_token_hash TEXT, 
	previous_token_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	token_rollback_hash TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	archived_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES device_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_devices_previous_token_hash ON devices (previous_token_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_devices_status ON devices (status)

CREATE TABLE user_sessions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	refresh_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	client_type VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	client_name VARCHAR(160), 
	ip_address VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (refresh_token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_user_sessions_user_revoked ON user_sessions (user_id, revoked_at)

CREATE TABLE automation_rules (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	trigger_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	conditions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	action_command VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	action_payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	cooldown_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_runs_per_hour INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	dry_run BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	allow_disruptive BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_triggered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_automation_rules_trigger_enabled ON automation_rules (trigger_type, enabled)

CREATE TABLE client_profiles (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	policy JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_client_profiles_device_name UNIQUE (device_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE device_commands (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	command_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	result JSONB, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	picked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	source VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_device_commands_device_status ON device_commands (device_id, status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_device_commands_device_idempotency ON device_commands (device_id, idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE device_hardware_identities (
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	profile_id UUID, 
	observed JSONB NOT NULL, 
	resolved JSONB NOT NULL, 
	match_method VARCHAR(80), 
	match_confidence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(profile_id) REFERENCES hardware_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE device_telemetry (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_device_telemetry_device_created ON device_telemetry (device_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE device_telemetry_metrics (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rx_bps BIGINT, 
	tx_bps BIGINT, 
	rx_bytes BIGINT, 
	tx_bytes BIGINT, 
	load_1m FLOAT, 
	memory_percent FLOAT, 
	temperature_celsius FLOAT, 
	storage_percent FLOAT, 
	client_count INTEGER, 
	interfaces JSONB NOT NULL, 
	wifi JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_device_telemetry_metrics_device_created ON device_telemetry_metrics (device_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE event_records (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID, 
	event_type VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	event_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	occurrence_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	snoozed_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_event_records_device_occurred ON event_records (device_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_event_records_fingerprint_last ON event_records (fingerprint, last_occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_event_records_type_status ON event_records (event_type, status)

CREATE TABLE feedback_records (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID, 
	device_id UUID, 
	source VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	app_version VARCHAR(40), 
	client_context JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_feedback_records_created ON feedback_records (created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_feedback_records_status_created ON feedback_records (status, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE hardware_sensor_samples (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	sensor_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(80), 
	label VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	subsystem VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	milli_celsius INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	warning_milli_celsius INTEGER, 
	critical_milli_celsius INTEGER, 
	observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_hardware_sensor_device_key ON hardware_sensor_samples (device_id, sensor_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_hardware_sensor_device_time ON hardware_sensor_samples (device_id, observed_at)

CREATE TABLE mobile_pairing_tokens (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	server_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	used_session_id UUID, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(used_session_id) REFERENCES user_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_mobile_pairing_tokens_user_created ON mobile_pairing_tokens (user_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE notification_rules (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	event_types JSONB NOT NULL, 
	severities JSONB NOT NULL, 
	channels JSONB NOT NULL, 
	quiet_hours JSONB NOT NULL, 
	notify_recovery BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_notification_rules_device_enabled ON notification_rules (device_id, enabled)

CREATE TABLE automation_runs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rule_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID, 
	command_id UUID, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	message TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rule_id) REFERENCES automation_rules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES event_records (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES device_commands (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_automation_runs_rule_created ON automation_runs (rule_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE network_clients (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	profile_id UUID, 
	mac VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(120), 
	vendor VARCHAR(160), 
	device_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	device_type_source VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	hostname VARCHAR(120), 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	interface VARCHAR(80), 
	online BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	presence_state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	presence_source VARCHAR(40), 
	last_observed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	online_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	presence_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	is_static BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	policy JSONB NOT NULL, 
	first_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_network_clients_device_mac UNIQUE (device_id, mac), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(profile_id) REFERENCES client_profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_network_clients_device_online ON network_clients (device_id, online)
CREATE INDEX ix_network_clients_device_presence ON network_clients (device_id, presence_state)

CREATE TABLE terminal_sessions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	device_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID, 
	command_id UUID, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	columns INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rows INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	last_activity_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	connected_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	close_reason TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(command_id) REFERENCES device_commands (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_terminal_sessions_device_status ON terminal_sessions (device_id, status)

CREATE TABLE client_activity_events (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(40), 
	ip_address VARCHAR(45), 
	interface VARCHAR(80), 
	occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES network_clients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_client_activity_client_occurred ON client_activity_events (client_id, occurred_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE client_traffic_samples (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rx_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	tx_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES network_clients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_client_traffic_client_created ON client_traffic_samples (client_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE terminal_frames (
	id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	frame_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	payload BYTEA, 
	frame_data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES terminal_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_terminal_frames_session_direction_id ON terminal_frames (session_id, direction, id)
